blocks.title: Rectification
blocks.text: AC (alternating current) ko DC (direct current) mein badalne ke process (amal) ko rectification kehte hain.

Diode current ko ek direction (simt) mein guzarne deta hai (forward bias) aur ulti direction mein rok deta hai (reverse bias). Rectification do types (qism) ki hai: half wave aur full wave. Computer aur smartphone jaise devices (aalaat) ko stable (mustaqil) DC chahiye, jab ke ghar aur dukanon ki bijli AC hoti hai; is liye in mein rectification istemal hoti hai.
